nodes.description: Constant storage slot holding the implementation address used by the proxy's delegatecall target.
Constant storage slot holding the proxy admin address used to authorize setImplementation.
Initializes the proxy by writing the implementation address and setting msg.sender as admin.
Public admin-gated function that overwrites the implementation slot; authorization relies on msg.sender compared to the admin slot.
Public view that reads and returns the current implementation address from the implementation slot.
Internal helper that reads a slot and casts it to an address.
Internal helper performing assembly sload on a given slot.
Internal helper performing assembly sstore on a given slot; writes implementation and admin slots.
Internal function that delegatecalls the implementation with the full calldata and forwards return data.
Payable fallback that delegates all unmatched calls to the implementation address read from the implementation slot.
Caller-controlled address; stored as admin in the constructor and checked in setImplementation.
Assembly delegatecall to an upgradeable implementation address, executing arbitrary code in the proxy's storage context.
Constructor parameter impl: initial implementation address written into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Parameter newImpl: new implementation address written into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Parameter key: storage slot key forwarded to _getSlotValue.
Parameter slot_ of _getSlotValue: slot read via assembly sload.
Return variable value_ of _getSlotValue: raw bytes32 read from storage.
Parameter slot_ of _setSlotValue: target slot for assembly sstore.
Parameter value_ of _setSlotValue: value written to the target slot.
Parameter implementation__ of _delegate: address targeted by delegatecall.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into ADMIN_SLOT by the constructor, making the admin privilege depend on the untrusted caller (e.g. via an unprotected initialization/deployment path).
setImplementation's authorization is require(msg.sender == _getAddress(ADMIN_SLOT)), so the untrusted caller directly gates a privileged upgrade action.
The constructor calls _setSlotValue twice to persist the implementation and admin slots.
The implementation address supplied to the constructor is stored in IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
The constructor stores msg.sender into ADMIN_SLOT.
setImplementation calls _getAddress(ADMIN_SLOT) to read the current admin for the authorization check.
setImplementation calls _setSlotValue to overwrite the implementation slot after the check.
setImplementation writes a new value into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
The admin value stored in ADMIN_SLOT is the sole authorization source for the upgrade action; corruption of that slot yields privilege escalation.
implementation() reads the implementation slot through _getSlotValue.
_getAddress delegates the raw storage read to _getSlotValue before casting to address.
The fallback resolves the implementation address via _getAddress(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).
The fallback forwards the resolved implementation address into _delegate.
The address returned by _getAddress flows into _delegate as the delegatecall target, which is fully controllable if the implementation slot is writable.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is read by the fallback path to determine the delegatecall destination.

_delegate performs an unchecked assembly delegatecall to an external contract with full calldata, allowing arbitrary code execution in the proxy's context; if the implementation is attacker-controlled this becomes a critical reentrancy/arbitrary-call vector.
Constructor parameter impl is packed and written into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Parameter newImpl is packed and written into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Parameter key is forwarded to _getSlotValue for the sload.
Parameter slot_ is used inside the assembly sload of _getSlotValue.
Return variable value_ receives the bytes32 loaded from storage in _getSlotValue.
Parameter slot_ is used inside the assembly sstore of _setSlotValue.
Parameter value_ is written to storage by the assembly sstore of _setSlotValue.
Parameter implementation__ is the attacker-influenceable target of the delegatecall inside _delegate.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter impl only exists to seed IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT and has no independent semantics outside the constructor's initialization flow.
The newImpl parameter is only used to overwrite the implementation slot inside the admin-gated setImplementation.
The key parameter is a pure forwarding argument to _getSlotValue and can be absorbed into the _getAddress read operation.
The slot_ parameter is consumed directly by the inline assembly sload and carries no separate graph semantics.
The value_ return variable is produced by the sload inside _getSlotValue and should be folded into that core function.
The slot_ parameter is consumed directly by the inline assembly sstore and belongs to the _setSlotValue write operation.
The value_ parameter is the data written by the assembly sstore and should be merged into _setSlotValue.
implementation__ is the direct target operand of the assembly delegatecall, so it should be merged into the unsafe_operation node.
